name: HackBot9000
tagline: A pre-ship review gate: stale deps, fake packages, toy login.
description: Point it at a pull request or an app near launch and it reviews what bot-written code most often gets wrong: stale dependencies, fake packages, authentication that would not survive a real attempt, and missing basic controls. It returns a plain ship or do-not-ship verdict. It reviews; it never merges or deploys.
author: fulg0re
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
